calendar_accounts_tokens_only_when_conne.name: calendar_accounts_tokens_only_when_connected
calendar_accounts_tokens_only_when_conne.value: `calendar_accounts`.`status` = 'connected' OR (`calendar_accounts`.`access_token_enc` IS NULL AND `calendar_accounts`.`refresh_token_enc` IS NULL)

calendar_event_refs_ownership_link.name: calendar_event_refs_ownership_link
calendar_event_refs_ownership_link.value: (`calendar_event_refs`.`ownership` = 'external' AND `calendar_event_refs`.`work_block_id` IS NULL) OR (`calendar_event_refs`.`ownership` = 'epiphany' AND `calendar_event_refs`.`event_id` IS NULL)

work_blocks_timestamps_match_status.name: work_blocks_timestamps_match_status
work_blocks_timestamps_match_status.value: (`work_blocks`.`status` = 'completed') = (`work_blocks`.`completed_at` IS NOT NULL) AND (`work_blocks`.`status` = 'removed') = (`work_blocks`.`removed_at` IS NOT NULL) AND (`work_blocks`.`status` = 'removed' OR `work_blocks`.`removed_reason` IS NULL)
